study: Owned finite saturation repair and nested source-occurrence conformance
literal_oracle: literal_observation and literal_result in tests/test_nested_trace_repair.py; direct arithmetic and fixed trace sites, without source parsing
source_site_convention: Zero-based source preorder by structural occurrence; visit if, then subtree, else subtree before the following statement, before executing any selected path. IDs are local to each program role, not runtime event ordinals or AST object identities.
raw_observations: report.json:cases[].observations stores literal, AST and concrete receiver observations for all 320 candidate-point pairs
paired_receiver_timing: receiver-timing.json: separate 20-fixture / 10-repetition / 200-samples-per-arm same-obligation measurement, not timing of the five owned variants
native_scope: These 320 candidate-point observations are interpreted finite semantics, not native C executions. Historical native fixture evidence is separate and unchanged.
historical_campaign_scope: The five requests supplement, rather than replace or enlarge, the retained 380-request core and 400-request grammar campaigns.
